name: Together AI
summary: Open-source AI infrastructure. Technical, blueprint-style design
description: An inspired interpretation of Together AI's design language — an AI infrastructure platform whose surface alternates between near-black hero bands (with a three-color orange-magenta-periwinkle gradient as the single piece of brand chrome) and bright white research / pricing / docs bands, knit together by a custom display sans and an uppercase mono eyebrow face.

colors.name: Ink Black
colors.role: The single primary CTA color. Black pill carries "Sign in", "Contact sales", "Get started now", every footer CTA.

colors.name: Brand Orange
colors.role: One leg of the three-color brand gradient. Appears in the hero ribbon graphic; never used as a UI fill on its own.

colors.name: Brand Magenta
colors.role: The second leg of the gradient.

colors.name: Brand Periwinkle
colors.role: The third leg of the gradient; also used as a soft fill for some stat tiles.

colors.name: Brand Mint
colors.role: A pastel cyan that lives outside the gradient — used for hero secondary-CTA pills and `stats-card-tinted` tiles.

colors.name: Canvas
colors.role: The default product / pricing / docs background.

colors.name: Hairline / Canvas Soft
colors.role: The brand's single soft surface tone — used for data-table header rows, toggle-pill rails, and 1 px dividers between table rows.

colors.name: Canvas Dark
colors.role: The brand's dark hero surface; appears on `hero-band-dark` and `research-band-dark`.

colors.name: Hairline
colors.role: 1 px dividers on light surfaces — table rows, card chrome, badge borders.

colors.name: Hairline on Dark
colors.role: 1 px dividers and badge backgrounds on `{colors.canvas-dark}` surfaces; pre-blended from the brand's translucent-white-on-dark hairline.

colors.name: Surface Dark Soft
colors.role: A slightly lighter dark fill used inside dark-band cards.

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: Every heading and body paragraph on light surfaces.

colors.name: Body
colors.role: Secondary text — captions, table cell secondary values, footer link text. Pre-blended from the brand's translucent-black 40 % body color.

colors.name: Body Muted
colors.role: The all-caps mono-eyebrow text color on light surfaces also rides on this token — there is no separate "mute" tone, the brand keeps secondary text consistent with caption text.

substitutesNote:
The two primary faces are proprietary. Open-source substitutes:
- **Display sans** — *Inter* (400 / 500) with `font-feature-settings: "ss01"` enabled comes closest; tighten letter-spacing by ~0.6 % at display sizes to land on the brand's compressed feel. *Geist* is the second-best option but reads slightly wider.
- **Uppercase mono eyebrow** — *JetBrains Mono* or *Geist Mono* (weight 500) at 11 px with `text-transform: uppercase` matches the brand's voice once tracking is bumped to `0.04em`.
